course: Legal Finance: The Business of Financing Legal Claims and Law Firms (LAWS 53571-01)
meets: Wednesdays 4:00-6:00 pm, Laird Bell Quadrangle IV

exam.format: No final exam. Engagement and participation 40%, group assignments 35%, individual final project 25%.

assignments.title: Group term sheet exercises
assignments.detail: Scenarios and assumptions discussed at end of Class 1.

assignments.title: Group project - draft funding agreements from the term sheets
assignments.detail: Plus attorney memoranda / investment committee memoranda. Instructions given during Class 3.

assignments.title: Difficult negotiations group exercise
assignments.detail: Run in Class 7. Scenarios and assumptions given during Class 6.

assignments.title: Final project topic due to instructor
assignments.detail: Approx. 15 double-spaced pages, topic must be approved.

assignments.title: In-seminar presentation of final project topic
assignments.detail: Short summary: the topic, why chosen, and its relevance to the course. Class 9.

assignments.title: Individual final project due
assignments.detail: First day of Spring Quarter 2027. Chicago Manual of Style citations. 100-point rubric in the syllabus.
